whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Ji Hujur,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 3.6★ reviews across 500+ diners in Kankarbagh, Patna, but currently relies on third-party aggregators instead of a direct ordering page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct online food ordering, table reservation, aur digital menu integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.swiggy.com/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Ji Hujur team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Ji Hujur in Kankarbagh) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct online food ordering and zero-commission menu features for your Patna diners. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes aur pricing setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
